title: Australian Style Gluten-Free Bread
description: A simple recipe for gluten-free bread using Australian ingredients and a buttermilk substitute.

ingredients.name: Gluten-free flour
ingredients.notes: can be replaced with almond flour

instructions: 2. In a blender, blend the crisp bread into crumbs.
3. In a large bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, salt, sugar, and xanthan gum (if using).
4. Add the softened butter and mix until the dough resembles coarse crumbs.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together the buttermilk substitute and eggs.
6. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
7. Add the bread crumbs and mix until the dough is smooth.
8. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic.
9. Place the dough in a greased loaf pan and bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
10. Let the bread cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing.
